docs.title: Olaverse Documentation
docs.text:
Welcome to the official developer documentation for the Olaverse SDK.

Olaverse is a unified Python package and developer interface designed to seamlessly integrate state-of-the-art African NLP features, Text-to-Speech (TTS) architecture, and Large Language Models (LLMs) into your applications.

docs.title: Key Capabilities
docs.text:
• 🗣️ Natural Language Processing: Accurate text diacritization (Yoruba, Igbo), Language Detection (covering 5 local languages), custom Byte-Level BPE tokenization, and robust PII masking.
  • 🎙️ Speech Synthesis: End-to-End Text-to-Speech (TTS) pipelines to translate normalized text and restored tones into high-fidelity audio waveforms.
  • 🧠 Large Language Models: Easy, memory-efficient inference interfaces for loading advanced domain-specific LLMs (like LegalPeace for legal contract reasoning).
  • 🌍 Global Utilities: Built-in constants, universal currency formatters, and generic .wav audio I/O tools.

docs.title: Quick Install
docs.text: pip install olaverse

docs.title: Navigation
docs.text:
• NLP & Tokenization: Explore the Tokenizer, Language Detection, Diacritization, and PII masking tools.
  • Speech Synthesis: Learn how to use the End-to-End TTSPipeline and extend it with custom Acoustic models.
  • Language Models: Explore how to run large models like LegalPeace and the Neural language detector.
  • Global Utilities: Check out the built-in generic constants and audio utilities.

docs.title: Large Language Models
docs.text: The olaverse.llm module provides interfaces for running computationally heavy transformer-based models, such as LLMs and deep neural detectors.

docs.title: Legal AI
docs.text: The LegalPeace interface makes it trivial to load the olaverse/legal-peace-v1.0 model. It utilizes unsloth for high-performance memory-efficient loading on GPUs.

docs.title: olaverse.llm.LegalPeace
docs.text: Interface for the LegalPeace model family. Base Model: Mistral-7B-v0.3 Fine-tuned for Contract Analysis & Legal Reasoning.

docs.title: load()
docs.text: Load the model and tokenizer using unsloth.

docs.title: Neural Language Detection
docs.text: For maximum accuracy (98.96%), the LIDNeural5 uses a full Hugging Face transformer backend to classify Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo, Pidgin, and English.

docs.title: olaverse.llm.LIDNeural5
docs.text: Interface for the LIDNeural5 transformer-based language detection model. Base Model: microsoft/Multilingual-MiniLM-L12-H384 Fine-tuned on 5 languages: Yoruba ('yor'), Hausa ('hau'), Igbo ('ibo'), Pidgin ('pcm'), and English ('eng').

docs.title: load()
docs.text: Load the model and tokenizer using transformers.

docs.title: predict(text)
docs.text: Predict the language of the text. Returns: 'yor', 'hau', 'ibo', 'pcm', or 'eng'.

docs.title: predict_proba(text)
docs.text: Predict the language probabilities for the text.

docs.title: NLP & Tokenization
docs.text: The olaverse.nlp module provides tools for manipulating text, breaking it into optimized tokens, normalizing numbers for speech, and seamlessly restoring diacritics for African languages.

docs.title: olaverse.nlp.clean_text(text, remove_urls=True, remove_html=True)
docs.text: General text cleaning utility. Strips extra whitespaces, and optionally removes URLs and HTML tags.

docs.title: olaverse.nlp.mask_pii(text)
docs.text: Mask general Personally Identifiable Information (PII) globally. Replaces Emails, Credit Cards, Social Security Numbers (SSN), and Phone numbers.

docs.title: olaverse.nlp.TTSNormalizer
docs.text: Normalizes text for TTS processing by expanding numbers, symbols, and abbreviations into full phonetic/spoken words based on the target language.

docs.title: expand_numbers(text)
docs.text: Expands digits into spoken words. Currently implements a basic digit-by-digit reading as a fallback. Can be extended to handle full localized number expansion logic.

docs.title: normalize(text)
docs.text: Applies all TTS normalization pipelines sequentially.

docs.title: olaverse.nlp.detect_language(text, model_path='lid-lite-5.json')
docs.text: Detect the language of the given text using LIDLite5. Returns: 'yor' (Yoruba), 'hau' (Hausa), 'ibo' (Igbo), 'pcm' (Pidgin), or 'eng' (English).

docs.title: olaverse.nlp.LIDLite5
docs.text: Lightweight, zero-dependency TF-IDF + Logistic Regression Language Detector for 5 languages: Yoruba ('yor'), Hausa ('hau'), Igbo ('ibo'), Pidgin ('pcm'), and English ('eng').

docs.title: predict(text)
docs.text: Predict the language of the given text. Returns: 'yor', 'hau', 'ibo', 'pcm', or 'eng'.

docs.title: predict_proba(text)
docs.text: Predict the language probabilities using softmax over logits.

docs.title: olaverse.nlp.Diacritizer
docs.text: Unified interface for restoring diacritics in African languages using model IDs.

docs.title: olaverse.nlp.Tokenizer
docs.text: A unified BPE Tokenizer for Nigerian languages. Supports 'yoruba', 'igbo', 'hausa', 'pidgin', and 'naija' (unified).

docs.title: decode(ids)
docs.text: Decode a list of token IDs back into a string.

docs.title: encode(text)
docs.text: Encode input text into a list of token IDs.

docs.title: Speech Synthesis
docs.text: The olaverse.speech module provides a flexible, robust Text-to-Speech (TTS) architecture.

docs.title: TTS Pipeline
docs.text: The TTSPipeline coordinates the entire flow from raw text to output waveforms, automatically handling text normalization and diacritic restoration before passing inputs to your Acoustic models.

docs.title: olaverse.speech.TTSPipeline
docs.text:
End-to-end Text-to-Speech pipeline.

Orchestrates the entire flow: 1. Text Normalization (Numbers, abbreviations) 2. Tone Restoration (Diacritization) 3. Acoustic Modeling (Text -> Mel-spectrogram) 4. Vocoding (Mel-spectrogram -> Audio Waveform)

docs.title: synthesize(text)
docs.text: Synthesize raw text into an audio waveform.

docs.title: Model Interfaces
docs.text: If you are training or integrating custom Acoustic models and Vocoders, ensure they inherit from these base classes.

docs.text:

Abstract base class for Acoustic Models (e.g., FastSpeech, Tacotron). These models convert normalized/diacritized phonetic text into acoustic features like Mel-spectrograms.
